task: Fix Session Modal subtitle overflow by constraining the Popup header wrapper and showing the full subtitle in a tooltip only when truncated

component_scope.label: S
component_scope.affected: Popup (shared modal primitive), SessionModal (feature component), SessionSubtitle (tooltip wrapper)

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Tooltip activation timing after the session loads asynchronously was not foreseen in the original fix and required a follow-up commit; tooltip target also needed to be scoped per modal instance.

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: Tooltip-never-activating race condition against async session load; tooltip DOM target collision across multiple modal instances sharing a class selector
technical_risk.mitigation: Attached useIsTruncated via a dedicated SessionSubtitle component so the ref mounts with real content, and scoped the tooltip target selector per traceId; added regression tests for truncation and for the close button staying visible with a long header

key_reasoning.reason: A tooltip-never-activating race against the async session load, plus a tooltip-target collision across stacked modal instances, surfaced only during implementation and needed two follow-up fixes (separate commits) beyond the initial header-wrapper constraint.
5 files touched across 2 directories (shared Popup primitive plus the SessionModal feature and its two test files), all modifications — no new files created.
